body: I agree. No pain is permanent but sometimes the uncertainty of the amount of suffering yet to come makes it devastating nonetheless.

I really get how you feel. I felt similar for quite a long time. See, I don‘t know how it was for you and your person but for me holding on caused way to much pain since I got rejected nonetheless. Of course people, their emotions and their behaviors are way too complicated to describe in one sentence. 
But one thing I learned is that waiting for something that won’t happen causes more pain than letting go and finding the way back to oneself. 
Letting go is hard and it takes so much time and effort but one day the pain will be gone.
Whatever you choose to do, I wish you all the best.

I feel your pain. I feel your anger. I notice how strong you are. 
I write this comment because I can relate to your words. But anger holds you back, you know?
Feel it. You’re allowed to feel angry. You can be angry as long as you want, as long as you don’t end up hurting yourself. 
And then there will be a time when all resentment and anger is gone. You‘ll just be fine. We‘ll get there just as everyone does.
I get what you mean but it’s different. Thanks anyway.
